unit_system: natural-HEP: GeV for beam energies and sqrt(s); luminosity in cm^-2 s^-1 as the facility documents quote it; polarization as a fraction or percent, stated per claim
energy_variable: beam energies E_e x E_h per named collision configuration (GeV; per nucleon for ions) with sqrt(s) derived and stated alongside; never a single implicit energy
frame: laboratory frame with asymmetric beams: the lab and center-of-mass frames differ, and every boost or crossing-angle correction is stated per configuration from its source
eic:beam_energy_configuration: a named pair (E_e, E_h) with species and polarization, taken from the cited source and release; this profile does not fix a default configuration
rapidity_frame: laboratory frame; the +z direction (along the hadron or the electron beam) is unknown: this profile does not fix it, and the analysis or the ePIC geometry it uses states it
polarization_convention: helicity and transverse-polarization sign conventions are unknown: this profile does not fix them; take them from the cited analysis (see the hep-theory pages polarized-dis.md and sidis-and-tmd.md)
eic:ion_energy_normalization: ion beam energies are per nucleon unless a claim says whole-ion; every conversion states A and Z. This concerns the beam energy, not the cross-section target_normalization
target_normalization: per nucleon or per nucleus, stated by the analysis; this profile does not fix it
azimuth_convention: named by the analysis (for example Trento); this profile does not fix it
eic:crossing_angle_treatment: the analysis states whether it boosts to the head-on frame and where the crossing angle comes from; this profile does not fix it
